newsitem.title: USA: Sunbeam's Dunlap eyes sale or purchase - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Sunbeam's Dunlap eyes sale or purchase - WSJ.

text.p: Sunbeam Corp Chairman Albert Dunlap is exploring options, including a possible sale of the company or making a large acquisition, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.

The newspaper said a Sunbeam spokesman confirmed Dunlap was talking to investment bankers about the alternatives as well as a share buyback program but did not provide details about potential targets or acquirors.
The spokesman said an acquisition or sale would likely not come until next year although Sunbeam could choose which path to take this year, the Journal said.
